name: ESRS — simplified set (2026 revision)
source: Commission adoption of revised ESRS, 2026-07-03; application follows completion of the scrutiny period and publication in the Official Journal
honesty_note: Adopted but not yet applicable at the time of writing. The engine reports this version for forward planning and diffing; in-force assessments default to esrs_2023 until the revision enters into force.

reduction_vs_2023.note: Reductions as announced by the Commission at adoption ('more than' these percentages); precise revised counts are declared when the final published text is ingested.

key_changes: Double materiality remains the basis for determining reportable information.
Mandatory datapoints reduced by more than 60%; total datapoints by more than 70%.
Simplified materiality assessment process and reduced granularity across topical standards.
Closer alignment with the value-chain cap: information requests to companies below CSRD scope are limited to the VSME voluntary standard coverage.

structure.note: Standard set unchanged in structure; disclosure requirements and datapoints within each standard are simplified. Detailed revised disclosure-requirement lists are ingested from the published text when it enters into force.
